title: On the solvability of parameter estimation-based observers for nonlinear systems
summary: Parameter estimation-based observer (PEBO) is a recently developed constructive tool to design state observers for nonlinear systems. It reformulates the state estimation problem as one of online parameter identification, effectively addressing many open estimation challenges in practical applications. The feasibility of a PEBO design relies on two fundamental properties: transformability and identifiability.
